O nas

Tworzymy i rozwijamy autorskie produkty oraz dedykowane aplikacje dla dużych polskich i międzynarodowych przedsiębiorstw. Budujemy je w architekturze mikroserwisowej, w Javie, .NET, Node.js, TypeScripcie i uruchamiamy w kontenerach.

Nasze systemy działają w All for One Data Center, w infrastrukturach klientów oraz w chmurach publicznych: AWS, Azure i GCP. Wybór dostawcy chmury nie jest tu kluczowy, ponieważ pracujemy przede wszystkim z warstwą aplikacyjną i z procesem jej dostarczania.

Rekrutujemy do Działu Rozwoju Oprogramowania
, dlatego stanowisko jest bliżej obszaru Dev niż Ops
. Infrastrukturę przygotowuje i utrzymuje nasz dział IT lub klient: system operacyjny, sieć, silnik Dockera oraz klaster Kubernetes.

Twoja odpowiedzialność zaczyna się warstwę wyżej, przy aplikacji i procesie jej dostarczania. Część zagadnień planujemy wspólnie z IT, dlatego cenimy zrozumienie również warstwy niższej. Szukamy osoby, która zadba o to, aby nasze rozwiązania można było sprawnie zbudować, wdrożyć i utrzymać w każdym środowisku, w którym pracują.

Do Twoich Zadań Będzie Należeć

rozwój i utrzymanie procesów CI/CD dla aplikacji w Javie, .NET i Node.js/TypeScripcie,
przygotowywanie obrazów kontenerów oraz pakowanie wdrożeń w Helm charty, wersjonowane dla poszczególnych środowisk i klientów,
wdrażanie aplikacji na klaster Kubernetes i konfiguracja warstwy kontenerowej, w tym zasobów, limitów i skalowania,
konfiguracja komponentów warstwy aplikacyjnej, na przykład serwerów aplikacyjnych i reverse proxy, oraz automatyzacja tych czynności w Ansible,
automatyzacja instalacji i aktualizacji produktu, również w środowiskach klientów,
konfiguracja i rozwój monitoringu, zbierania logów oraz alertowania,
rozbudowa pipeline’ów o bramki jakościowe: analizę SonarQube, testy automatyczne i skanowanie zależności,
zarządzanie konfiguracją i sekretami aplikacji w sposób bezpieczny dla środowisk produkcyjnych,
udział w projektowaniu rozwiązań: strategie wdrożeń bez przestoju, skalowalność, spójność środowisk deweloperskich, testowych i produkcyjnych,
wsparcie zespołów deweloperskich w diagnostyce problemów środowiskowych.

Wymagania

minimum 3 lata doświadczenia zawodowego w obszarze CI/CD i automatyzacji dostarczania oprogramowania,
praktyczna znajomość Dockera: budowanie i optymalizacja obrazów, sieci, wolumeny, diagnostyka,
doświadczenie w pracy z Kubernetesem w środowiskach produkcyjnych oraz umiejętność diagnozowania problemów z uruchamianiem i wydajnością aplikacji w klastrze,
znajomość Helma na poziomie tworzenia i utrzymania własnych chartów,
umiejętność pisania idempotentnych playbooków i ról w Ansible,
doświadczenie z Jenkinsem i GitHub Actions w modelu pipeline as code,
swobodna praca z Gitem i SonarQube w zespole deweloperskim,
znajomość narzędzi monitoringu i analizy logów; naszym standardem są Prometheus, Grafana oraz Loki lub Graylog,
dobra znajomość systemu Linux oraz umiejętność pisania skryptów w Bashu,
język angielski na poziomie co najmniej B2, ponieważ pracujemy w środowisku międzynarodowym.

Mile Widziane

znajomość Terraform, przynajmniej na poziomie czytania i rozumienia kodu; infrastrukturę planujemy wspólnie z działem IT,
znajomość jednego z języków, w których tworzymy nasze produkty: Javy, TypeScriptu lub .NET, w zakresie pozwalającym analizować kod aplikacji i jej wymagania uruchomieniowe,
doświadczenie z podejściem GitOps oraz narzędziami ArgoCD lub Flux,
doświadczenie operacyjne z bazami PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra lub Solr,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI w pracy inżynierskiej, w tym GitHub Copilot oraz rozwiązań opartych o modele językowe,
certyfikaty potwierdzające kompetencje w obszarze DevOps.

Oferujemy

Możliwość pracy hybrydowej - 2 dni w tygodniu z biura w Poznaniu na ul. Ratajczaka,
Pracę przy rozwoju produktów, a nie w obszarze utrzymania zgłoszeń,
Wpływ na kształt procesów CI/CD i standardy techniczne w zespołach produktowych,
Kontakt z kilkoma stosami technologicznymi w ramach jednej architektury,
Możliwość rozwoju w kierunku platform engineeringu, SRE lub architektury rozwiązań,
Pracę w zgranym, nastawionym na rozwój zespole, otwartym na nowe pomysły i dzielenie się wiedzą.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Service Delivery/IX Platform
jobs.description:
We are seeking an Engineer
to join our global IX Platform team, where innovation knows no borders. This role is part of a larger transition and a dedicated team being created in Kraków. This team designs, builds, and evolves modern cloud-native backend services and distributed architectures that power mission-critical travel and airline technology solutions worldwide. By delivering high-availability systems, robust APIs, and scalable data flows, the team enables travel disruptors and established leaders to retail, distribute, and fulfill travel at scale. With an inclusive culture and flexible work environment, we work together with boldness, curiosity, and commitment so we can all win together.

As an Engineer on the IX Platform team in Kraków, you will build and support resilient microservices, messaging patterns, and cloud-native backend components. You will collaborate across Product, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Delivery teams to translate platform vision into production-ready software. Takes ownership of services from design through implementation, deployment, and production support. This role demands strong backend engineering fundamentals, a commitment to clean code, and constructive problem-solving to maintain high reliability across enterprise distributed systems.

What You'll Do

Service Lifecycle: Take ownership of services from design through implementation, deployment, and production support.
Backend Engineering: Design, develop, test, and maintain high-performance backend services using Java and modern JDK capabilities.
API Development: Build, consume, and document secure, well-structured RESTful and SOAP APIs and integration services for high-availability systems.
Cloud Operations: Deploy and operate containerized microservices in cloud environments, focusing on Google Cloud Platform, GKE, Cloud Run, and automated deployment patterns.
Distributed Systems: Implement asynchronous, event-driven communication patterns using messaging technologies, queues, and event streams.
Data Management: Optimize relational database schemas, SQL queries, transactions, caching mechanisms, and data access layers for consistency and scale.
Quality & Code Health: Author production-quality code with unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and drive continuous engineering improvements.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams to refine technical requirements, evaluate design trade-offs, and support operational readiness through logging, monitoring, and incident diagnostics.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Strong hands-on experience with Java backend development, modern JDK versions, JVM fundamentals, concurrency, and performance tuning.
Proven experience designing, developing, consuming, and maintaining REST and SOAP APIs, including API security, contracts, and versioning.
Practical experience with cloud-native architectures and containerization tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or Google Cloud Platform services.
Solid understanding of distributed systems principles, microservices patterns, service discovery, resiliency, messaging systems (e.g., Pub/Sub, Kafka, RabbitMQ), and key resilience/consistency mechanisms including retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, idempotency, consistency, latency, and failure handling.
Hands-on experience with relational databases, SQL schema design, query optimization, data modeling, and modern CI/CD practices.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or similar Java backend frameworks.
Hands-on experience with GCP-native services such as GKE, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Memorystore, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace, or Cloud Build.
Experience with Kafka or high-volume event streaming platforms.
Experience designing systems for high availability, horizontal scaling, disaster recovery, and performance under load.
Experience with OpenAPI/Swagger, API gateways, OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, mTLS, enterprise identity integrations, or NoSQL/caching technologies like PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, Redis, or Elasticsearch.
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Helm.
Domain experience in travel, airline, retailing, distribution, booking, or fulfillment enterprise systems.

jobs.title: Senior .NET utvecklare
jobs.description:
Att jobba som Senior .NET utvecklare

Vi söker en senior .NET utvecklare som vill bli en del av ett team som bygger och utvecklar affärskritiska system inom försäkringsområdet. Du kommer att arbeta nära mjukvaruarkitekter, produktägare, testare och andra utvecklare för att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla högkvalitativa lösningar som är säkra, skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara.

Tillsammans med teamet deltar du i arbete kring krav, design och systemarkitektur och bidrar till välgrundade tekniska beslut. Rollen har ett tydligt fokus på backendutveckling i .NET/C#, samtidigt som du även kommer att arbeta med och vidareutveckla interna frontendlösningar i React.

Utvecklingsarbetet sker i en eventdriven arkitektur inom en säkerhetskritisk miljö med stora datamängder och höga krav på tillförlitlighet, prestanda och stabilitet. Du arbetar med integrationer mot andra system och deltar aktivt i det kontinuerliga arbetet med att förbättra kodkvalitet, tekniska lösningar och teamets arbetssätt.

För att lyckas i rollen

Vi söker dig som är svensktalande och trivs i en utvecklarroll där kvalitet, säkerhet och driftsstabila system står i fokus. Du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med affärskritiska applikationer och känner dig trygg i att ta ägandeskap för tekniska lösningar genom hela utvecklingskedjan – från idé och design till implementation, vidareutveckling och optimering.

Du har ett strukturerat och analytiskt arbetssätt och uppskattar att samarbeta nära andra utvecklare i ett teamorienterat arbetssätt. Samtidigt delar du gärna med dig av din kompetens och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla både teamets arbetssätt och de tekniska plattformarna.

Vi tror också att du är nyfiken på ny teknik och intresserad av att ligga i framkant, exempelvis inom AI-stödd systemutveckling, och ser värdet i verktyg som GitHub Copilot för att skapa ännu bättre lösningar.

Vi Söker Dig Som Har Erfarenhet Av

Systemutveckling i C# och .NET
Backendutveckling och systemintegrationer
Eventdriven arkitektur eller meddelandebaserade lösningar, gärna NServiceBus eller RabbitMQ
Utveckling av RESTful API:er
Relationsdatabaser, gärna SQL Server, samt ORM-verktyg som EF Core
Git och moderna CI/CD-flöden

Vad händer nu?

Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet.

Läs mer om hela vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Robert Blomqvist på robert.blomqvist@skandia.se

Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocess, vänligen ta kontakt med Madelene Skogh på madelene.skogh@skandia.se

Vi kommer att återkoppla till alla som söker oavsett om du går vidare eller inte.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Mer om IT

Vi på Skandia IT är stolta över att vara en kundorienterad enhet som levererar effektiva och säkra lösningar för våra kunder. Med cirka 600 engagerade medarbetare är vi mitt i en spännande transformationsresa, där vi utvecklas tillsammans och har kul på vägen. Framåt tillsammans är vårt motto! 

Vi arbetar agilt och har sedan 2017 använt oss av SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) ramverket, där leverans och kundvärde alltid står i centrum. Våra tågledningar och team, jobbar verksamhetsbaserat med aktiviteter som sprintplanering, daily stand-ups, team-synk, code reviews och retrospektiv. 

Var 12:e vecka samlas vi alla i vår ljusa och inspirerande Ljusgård på kontoret i Stockholm för 2 planeringsdagar. Planeringsperioden består av 6 tvåveckorssprintar, där den sista sprinten är en innovationssprint. Här får du chansen att, själv eller tillsammans med ditt team, utveckla och förfina våra system.

jobs.title: Senior .NET-utvecklare – API & tekniskt ledarskap
jobs.description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten

Vill du fortsätta vara hands-on i utvecklingen, men samtidigt få större möjlighet att påverka tekniska beslut och hur API-utvecklingen ska bedrivas?

Vi söker en senior .NET-utvecklare till ett mindre utvecklingsteam som arbetar med att modernisera en etablerad produkt (Lönessystemet POL). Fokus ligger på att utveckla API:er i C#/.NET med Kubernetes i en miljö där ny teknik möter befintlig arkitektur, kod och data.

Du kommer in i ett läge där det finns mycket att påverka. En del handlar om att bygga nytt, en annan om att förstå vad som redan finns och avgöra vad som ska behållas, förändras eller byggas om.

Teamet är litet och du kommer in som en nyckelperson från start. Med din seniora API-kompetens kliver du rakt in i de tekniska diskussionerna tillsammans med övriga seniora kollegor och får möjlighet att påverka både lösningar och vägval direkt. Här är det kort väg mellan idé och beslut och du får stort utrymme att förändra och förbättra. Du är samtidigt en del av det dagliga utvecklingsarbetet – det här är tekniskt ledarskap, inte personalansvar.

Vi använder givetvis AI som ett naturligt verktyg inom utvecklingen, men söker hela tiden nästa steg inom agentbaserad utveckling, som kan användas för att utveckla våra arbetssätt och lösningar.

Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du framför allt att:

Designa och utveckla moderna API:er i C#/.NET i en Kubernetes-baserad miljö.
Vara med och modernisera vår befintliga produkt med dess legacylösningar och göra tekniska vägval för hur de ska utvecklas vidare.
Ta ansvar för API-lösningen hela vägen från design och implementation men även vara djupt delaktig i hosting, CI/CD och deployment.
Vägleda andra utvecklare och vara ett stöd i tekniska diskussioner och vägval.
Ansvara för designfrågor kring bland annat idempotency, atomicity och concurrency.
Sätta dig in i befintlig kod, datamodeller och stored procedures och bedöma vad som kan återanvändas och vad som behöver förändras.
Samarbeta med DevOps- och infrastrukturkompetenser kring drift och deployment.
Bidra till och driva utvecklingen av teamets arbetssätt, bland annat inom AI och agentbaserad utveckling.

Vi tror på värdet av att träffas och arbeta tillsammans på plats. Det skapar både ett effektivt arbetssätt och ett nära samarbete i teamet. Därför ser vi gärna att du är på vårt kontor i Solna 2–3 dagar i veckan.

Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren utvecklare och som är van att arbeta med API:er i komplexa systemmiljöer. För den här rollen är det särskilt viktigt att du har erfarenhet av API:er som skapar och uppdaterar verksamhetskritiska data.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:

Mycket god erfarenhet av C#/.NET och API-utveckling, inklusive design och implementation av API:er för create- och update-operationer.
God förståelse för robust API-design, exempelvis concurrency, idempotency, retries, atomicity, transaktioner och datakonsistens.
Erfarenhet av lösningar där flera beroende databasändringar behöver genomföras tillsammans eller rullas tillbaka vid fel.
Erfarenhet av att integrera moderna API-lösningar med legacysystem och bedöma vad som kan återanvändas, behöver refaktoreras eller byggas om.
Förståelse för API:ets hela livscykel, inklusive containers, hosting, CI/CD och deployment.
Förmåga att göra välgrundade tekniska och arkitekturella vägval och förankra dem i teamet.
Förmåga att ta tekniskt ansvar och vägleda andra utvecklare, samtidigt som du själv arbetar hands-on.
Svenska i tal och skrift på professionell nivå.

Det är mycket meriterande om du har praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes och är van att deploya och drifta containeriserade applikationer. Erfarenhet av exempelvis Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, kubectl, YAML och Helm är särskilt relevant för vår miljö.

Erfarenhet av Azure, tekniskt arkitekturarbete, API- och applikationssäkerhet eller AI-assisterad/agentbaserad utveckling är meriterande.

Eftersom vi är ett litet team lägger vi stor vikt vid hur du fungerar tillsammans med andra. Vi söker dig som delar med dig av det du kan och samtidigt är öppen för andras perspektiv. Du kan stå för dina tekniska bedömningar och vågar ifrågasätta när du ser en bättre väg, utan att tappa samarbetet på vägen. Du tar ansvar för det du driver och är bekväm med att ta reda på vad som behövs när allt inte är färdigdefinierat.

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen genomförs bakgrundskontroll i form av kredit- och registerkontroll. Godkänd kontroll krävs för anställning.

Om du har några frågor eller funderingar, kontakta gärna rekryterade chef Carl Gerhardsson via mail carl.gerhardsson@cgi.com

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.

Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.

Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.

Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.

Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.

Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

jobs.title: .NET-utvecklare – från backend till frontend
jobs.description:
Fullstackutvecklare med .NET i grunden

Vill du fortsätta utvecklas – utan att behöva välja mellan backend och frontend?

På Nexer söker vi kontinuerligt erfarna fullstackutvecklare till våra kunduppdrag i Göteborgsområdet. Vi söker dig som har .NET som en naturlig grund, men som gärna rör dig över hela stacken och tycker om att förstå lösningen som helhet.

Som konsult hos oss kan du arbeta med allt från produktutveckling och digitala tjänster till integrationsplattformar och affärskritiska verksamhetssystem. Våra kunder finns inom flera olika branscher, både i privat och offentlig sektor.

Gemensamt för uppdragen är att vi söker utvecklare som vill mer än att bara lösa nästa ticket. Du gillar att förstå problemet, diskutera lösningen och vara med och påverka hur den faktiskt byggs.

Vad du kan komma att arbeta med

Uppdragen ser olika ut beroende på kund, men ofta handlar det om att:

utveckla API, tjänster och backendlösningar med C# och .NET
bygga moderna webbapplikationer med exempelvis React, Angular, Vue eller Blazor
designa och utveckla integrationer mellan system och tjänster
arbeta med databaser, säkerhet, autentisering och behörighet
utveckla och driftsätta lösningar i Azure eller andra molnmiljöer
arbeta med Docker, Kubernetes och moderna CI/CD-flöden
diskutera arkitektur och tekniska vägval tillsammans med team och kund

Exakt vilka tekniker du arbetar med kommer att variera mellan uppdragen. För oss är det viktigare att du har en stabil teknisk grund, är nyfiken och kan sätta dig in i nya problem än att du kan bocka av varje teknik i en lista.

AI har blivit en del av utvecklarens verktygslåda

AI kommer att fortsätta förändra hur vi utvecklar mjukvara – och söker därför dig som redan har börjat använda AI som en naturlig del av ditt arbete.

Du kanske använder GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude eller liknande verktyg för att utveckla, analysera, felsöka, testa eller dokumentera kod. Det viktiga är inte vilket verktyg du använder, utan att du har börjat hitta sätt att arbeta smartare med hjälp av AI och samtidigt kan bedöma kvaliteten på det som faktiskt produceras.

Har du dessutom börjat experimentera med AI-agenter, agentiska arbetsflöden, MCP eller egna verktyg och integrationer är det extra intressant. Du behöver inte vara AI-specialist – men vi gillar utvecklare som är nyfikna på vart utvecklingen är på väg och gärna testar själva.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har minst fem års professionell erfarenhet av systemutveckling
och som känner dig trygg i rollen som utvecklare.

Du har:

flera års erfarenhet av C# och .NET
erfarenhet av minst ett modernt frontendramverk
arbetat i agila utvecklingsteam och är van att samarbeta med andra utvecklare, testare och verksamhet
förståelse för API, databaser, integrationer och moderna systemarkitekturer
erfarenhet av att använda AI-verktyg i ditt arbete som utvecklare
mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

Som konsult behöver du också trivas med att komma in i nya sammanhang, lära känna en ny verksamhet och kunna diskutera både problem och lösningar med kunden.

Du behöver inte kunna allt. Det gör ingen. Men efter några år i yrket har du förmodligen hunnit bli riktigt bra på vissa saker – och samtidigt upptäckt hur mycket mer det finns kvar att lära sig.

Extra intressant är det om du har erfarenhet av

Azure eller andra molnplattformar
Docker och Kubernetes
Clean Architecture, DDD eller liknande arkitekturmönster
eventdrivna och distribuerade system
säkerhet, autentisering och Entra ID/OAuth2/OIDC
tekniskt ledarskap eller att driva arkitektur- och designfrågor
att bygga lösningar där AI, LLM eller AI-agenter är en del av själva applikationen

jobs.title: Area Software Architect - Communication Area
jobs.description:
Every day, millions of messages are created, personalized, scheduled, and delivered through Voyado Engage. Behind that seemingly simple experience lies one of the most complex distributed systems in our platform.

As retailers expect richer personalization, more channels, and increasingly real-time experiences, that complexity is only growing. Our Communication Area owns the end-to-end communication platform, from content creation and personalization to orchestration, delivery, and message tracking across multiple channels.

We’re now continuing to evolve the architecture behind that platform. This isn’t about maintaining what already exists. It’s about making sure a business-critical system can keep evolving as our ambitions, volumes, and customer expectations grow.

About The Role

As Area Architect, you’ll help set the technical direction across the Communication Area. You’ll work closely with engineering teams, tech leads, Area Leadership, and fellow architects, helping teams make architectural decisions that balance what we need to deliver today with where the platform needs to be years from now.

This role is about seeing the system beyond individual services and features. You’ll challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities before they become blockers, and help teams understand how local decisions affect scalability, reliability, and the evolution of the communication platform as a whole.

As part of the Area Leadership, you’ll work alongside our Engineering Manager, Product Lead, and UX Lead, shaping both what we build and how we build it.

Some of the things you'll be up to:

Shape the technical direction of the Communication Area together with tech leads, engineering teams, and Area Leadership
Guide teams through architectural trade-offs around scalability, reliability, performance, developer experience, and long-term maintainability
Review and challenge significant technical proposals, exploring alternatives and strengthening designs before decisions become difficult to reverse
Look beyond today’s roadmap to identify emerging technical risks, opportunities, and foundational investments that will matter in the years ahead
Facilitate architectural discussions across teams, creating shared direction rather than isolated solutions
Coach tech leads and senior engineers, helping them strengthen their architectural thinking and technical leadership
Collaborate with architects across Voyado to ensure the Communication Area evolves as part of a coherent Engage platform

So, who are you?

We believe you’re an experienced architect or senior technical leader who enjoys working with complex distributed systems where technical decisions have real impact at scale.

You combine curiosity with decisiveness. You’ll be joining teams with years of accumulated knowledge about the communication platform, and you won’t be expected to walk in with all the answers. Instead, you take the time to understand the system, its history, and the reasoning behind existing decisions before setting a new direction.

You naturally look beyond individual components to understand dependencies, downstream effects, and how today’s decisions shape tomorrow’s platform.

We believe you have:

Architectural leadership experience across multiple teams or domains, with a track record of guiding others toward consistent technical direction as a technical lead, architect or senior engineer.
Deep experience with distributed systems and event-driven architecture, including asynchronous processing, message queuing, delivery guarantees, retry strategies, idempotency, and fault tolerance
Experience with communication or messaging systems at scale, ideally covering several parts of the lifecycle from content creation and personalization to scheduling, delivery, and tracking
Experience designing integration architectures involving external systems or providers, such as email, SMS, push, or similar delivery services

Experience with .NET/C#, Azure, high-volume transactional databases, content rendering or templating systems, or communication platforms such as martech, CRM, CDP, or email marketing products is highly valued.

What's in it for you?

Communication at scale is a genuinely difficult engineering problem. Reliability, personalization, automation, multi-channel complexity, external providers, and high message volumes all need to work together as one coherent system. You’ll be joining while we’re actively investing in the next generation of that platform, including greater channel extensibility, deeper personalization, and more sophisticated automation. That means real architectural problems to solve and the mandate to influence how we solve them.

Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers, and some examples of what we can offer you are:

You’ll operate in a culture that values curiosity, open discussion, and constructive challenge - where good ideas triumphs hierarchy
Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture; we value engagement over hours worked.

Some of our benefits:

30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
Breakfast buffet on Fridays
In-house gym only for Voyadoers
A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
Parental leave top-up: additional support for new parents
A wellness hour you can use every week

About Voyado

Voyado is the ultimate solution for personalization and relevance across all channels—online and offline. Used by retailers and e-commerce companies worldwide, Voyado makes it possible for every brand to engage customers, elevate shopping experiences, and evolve their own businesses.

We are now a company of 350+ colleagues on an exciting journey and have recently established a presence in new markets to strengthen our position in Europe. If you are ready for your next adventure and want to join our team on our expansion throughout Europe and have an interest in customer care, e-commerce, retail, and tech - let's get in touch!

Be yourself 🏳️‍🌈

At Voyado, we believe in gender equality. We are proud sponsors of Womengineer as well as Tjejer Kodar! Read more about Tjejer Kodar & Voyado here

Equality is not only about gender but also about making everyone feel welcome and heard in a multicultural and diverse environment. We at Voyado strive to make everyone feel like they can bring their true self to work every day. Gender-equal and diverse teams have more perspectives on life and bring different ideas to the table, which in the end leads not only to making a better working environment but also a better product.

Ready to find out more?

Lovely! 🎉

Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!

Making it personal with AI

We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human so please, bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice because that’s what we care about the most.

Note: As of right now we are unable to proceed with applicants outside of the EU, and a requirement of eligibility to work at Voyado is the right to work in the EU without limitations. Needless to say, this is something we are actively working on to be able to onboard colleagues from all over the world.

In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.

As the Agentic CX Suite for Retail we help retailers achieve a unified customer view through AI-powered CRM, loyalty management, product discovery, and advertising to increase customer lifetime value.

jobs.title: Salesforce Solution Architect
jobs.description:
At Polestar, you will have the opportunity to influence the future architecture of one of our most strategic commercial platforms, working at the intersection of customer experience, business transformation, and modern digital engineering.

The opportunity

Polestar is accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through electric performance. Digital Commercial plays a critical role in enabling customer growth, customer experience, sales, fleet and retailer operations, digital channels, and commercial excellence across all markets.

Salesforce is a strategic platform within Polestar's digital landscape, supporting customer engagement, sales, fleet operations, customer service, marketing, portals, AI-enabled experiences, and critical integrations with enterprise platforms such as ERP, integration platforms, data platforms, and other digital products.

As our business continues to evolve, we are strengthening our internal architecture capability and establishing clearer architectural ownership, standards, and governance across the Salesforce ecosystem. This role will help define the future direction of the platform, ensuring solutions remain scalable, secure, compliant, and aligned with Polestar's enterprise architecture.

This position is located at Gothenburg, Sweden. We believe in a hybrid model when it comes to remote and onsite work, knowing that both in-person collaboration and individual time to focus are needed. What matters most is that people get the time, and support, to do what needs to be done. And to enjoy doing it, of course.

Let us describe the challenge we offer

As a Salesforce Solution Architect, you will provide architectural leadership across Polestar's Salesforce landscape, spanning Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce, customer portals, fleet solutions, and related integrations. You will work closely with product managers, business stakeholders, engineers, enterprise architects, and external partners to ensure that solutions are aligned with both business objectives and long-term technology strategy.

The role requires balancing customer experience, business process efficiency, integration complexity, security requirements, and platform sustainability. You will help teams make the right architectural decisions while reducing technical debt, increasing reuse, and enabling faster delivery across multiple products and markets. You will be a key contributor in defining platform guardrails, integration patterns, data ownership principles, and future-state architecture for one of Polestar's most business-critical platforms.

What You'll Do

You will lead solution architecture across multiple initiatives and help shape the evolution of Polestar's Salesforce ecosystem.

See below for a more thorough breakdown of the various tasks and areas you'll be responsible for:

Designing scalable Salesforce solutions across customer, sales, service, fleet, and commercial domains
Leading solution architecture for strategic Salesforce initiatives and programmes
Defining architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails for Salesforce development
Ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and technology standards
Driving integration architecture across Salesforce, AWS, ERP systems, customer identity, data platforms, and digital products
Defining data ownership, master data, and information flow principles
Supporting product teams in architecture decisions, technical design, and solution governance
Ensuring solutions meet security, privacy, compliance, and audit requirements
Managing cross-team dependencies and reducing solution complexity
Driving platform scalability, maintainability, and operational excellence
Supporting roadmap planning and target architecture definition
Contributing to architecture reviews and governance forums
Mentoring engineers and supporting the broader architecture community

In your daily work, you will collaborate with teams across CRM, Customer Experience, Sales, Fleet, Marketing, Customer Care, Data & AI, Enterprise Architecture, and Digital Commercial leadership. You will also work closely with enterprise architects, chief architects, solution architects, product teams, and strategic partners.

Who You Are

You are comfortable navigating complex business domains and translating business needs into practical and sustainable Salesforce solutions. You can balance strategic thinking with hands-on architecture work and enjoy collaborating across business and technology teams. You have strong communication skills and can explain architectural concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You understand that great architecture is not just about technology. It is about enabling business outcomes while maintaining simplicity, governance, and long-term sustainability.

To be a great fit for this position, we believe you have:

Minimum 5 years of experience as a Solution Architect, Salesforce Architect, or Lead Salesforce Consultant
Deep knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities and architecture patterns
Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and Salesforce integrations
Experience designing APIs, event-driven integrations, and distributed solutions
Strong understanding of customer data management and enterprise integration patterns
Experience working with cloud-native architectures and modern development practices
Knowledge of security, privacy, identity, and compliance requirements
Experience working in agile product organisations
Ability to lead architecture across multiple teams and business domains

The Following Would Be Considered An Advantage

Salesforce certifications such as Application Architect, System Architect, or Certified Technical Architect (CTA)
Experience with Marketing Cloud or Agentforce
Experience integrating Salesforce with ERP, customer identity, and enterprise data platforms
Experience within automotive, retail, mobility, or direct-to-consumer digital businesses

Polestar is an international company, with various backgrounds represented. English, therefore, is the language of written and spoken communication. And though we have a global presence, we maintain the growth-mindset. Change happens often at Polestar. But so does progress. Expect an accelerating, exciting environment.

Is this you?

If the above matches your ambitions, be sure to apply. Our selection process is ongoing, and the job advert will remain open until it's filled.

The Polestar journey is an electric one.

Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About The Role

Production experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.

The Builder Experience

AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.
Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.
Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time. You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them.
Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.
You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Solution Architect - Aon Centre for Innovation and Analytics (ACIA)

Are you a problem solver and do you feel energised to roll up your sleeves and help deliver innovative analytics solutions through modern architecture and cloud native designs?

Do you want to be part of a driven, consultative, and well-respected team with a global remit to deliver capabilities to a large matrixed organisation?

Be a part of ACIA to help drive the digitalisation of the firm through modern technology and design!

This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Aon offices in Dublin.

Aon is in the business of better decisions

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

About ACIA

ACIA is leading the development of cloud-based analytics capability for Aon. With a diverse portfolio of projects on the horizon, and a sizeable production estate supporting an already successful business, we are in a critical growth phase and need the best minds in industry to help advance our journey.

What The Day Will Look Like

Working as a Solution Architect for ACIA, you will assume responsibility for the architecture of solutions that leverage advanced analytics, data pipelines, web portals, statistical models, Machine Learning and AI, through Aon’s Data and Analytics Services Platform (DASP).

You will typically work in project teams with Application Developers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Business Analysts, Product Owners and Program Managers in the delivery of these solutions, mainly for colleagues and clients of Aon’s Risk Capital division.

You will also draw on the strength and experience of a wider team of Solution Architects across Risk Capital, Enterprise Architecture and DASP. No day will ever be the same, but good design and diverse communication skills are a must, whether you are explaining a complex solution to a non-technical audience, eliciting details of complex business processes from subject matter experts, liaising with your project team, designing a solution, diagnosing an issue, or evaluating new technologies.

How This Opportunity Is Different

Our teams are a highly collaborative group, enthusiastic and technology-driven, striving for excellence in the solutions we provide for our colleagues who in turn serve our clients. We embrace challenges and rely on each other for support and creative problem solving. Working together, we can achieve great things!

Skills And Experience That Will Lead To Success

BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent
A number of years in a technical lead role in application development or architecture
Experience building and deploying complex applications, particularly event-driven cloud-native applications, as well as integrating enterprise solutions
Experience in Agile/DevOps, particularly Azure DevOps, consulting with application development teams on same
Cloud technology, ideally Azure PaaS services and serverless compute:
Azure Container Apps, App Service, Functions, API Management, App Gateway, Storage etc.
AWS PaaS - S3, Lambda, Step Functions, ECS, Docker, SNS, SQS, Kinesis, SageMaker etc. - also an advantage.

Understanding of distributed application design, patterns, and experience producing design diagrams and documenting standards
Experience in any modern data stack technologies a significant plus: Databricks, Airflow, Snowflake, StreamSets etc.

How We Support Our Colleagues

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage an inclusive workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon. Furthermore, all colleagues enjoy two “Global Wellbeing Days” each year, encouraging you to take time to focus on yourself. We offer a variety of working style solutions, but we also recognise that flexibility goes beyond just the place of work... and we are all for it. We call this Smart Working!

Our continuous learning culture inspires and equips you to learn, share and grow, helping you achieve your fullest potential. As a result, at Aon, you are more connected, more relevant, and more valued. We provide individuals with disabilities reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment in accordance with applicable law. Please contact us to request an accommodation on ReasonableAdjustments@Aon.com

Aon values an innovative, inclusive workplace where all colleagues feel empowered to be their authentic selves. Aon is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About The Role:

Does building systems that help security analysts close a critical incident before it becomes a breach excite you? Does correlating and analyzing data at trillions-of-events-per-day scale sound like the kind of challenge you want to wake up to? Do you care deeply about cybersecurity and want to play an active role in helping organizations defend themselves from sophisticated cyberattacks? We'd love to meet you.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Cloud to join our Threat Detection and Incident Response (TDIR) team, helping revolutionize security management with our AI-native Falcon Next-Gen SIEM platform – enabling customers to detect, investigate, and hunt down threats 150x faster at Petabyte scale.

You'll design, architect, and develop world-class case management and investigation capabilities in Go, empowering security analysts to be more effective at incident response, threat hunting, and collaborative investigations. You'll build intelligent workflows that connect detections, evidence, and response actions into cohesive cases. Leveraging advanced correlation, contextual enrichment, and AI/ML-powered insights, you'll help security teams work smarter through intelligent threat prioritization, automated investigation suggestions, and agentic analyst workflows – helping them respond faster to emerging threats.

While Go experience is preferred, strong backend engineers from other languages who can demonstrate rapid adaptability and a track record of delivering at scale are welcome to apply. If this is the kind of scale and impact you're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

8 + years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years building and operating distributed systems or cloud-native services at scale in production
Solid understanding of distributed systems, scalability, RESTful patterns, and multithreading concepts
Proficiency building and scaling resilient, low-latency services in production using Go, Python, Java, C++, or C#
Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms, preferably AWS or GCP
Strong communicator and collaborator across functions and levels, with a bias for ownership and a customer-first mindset
Proven ability to translate complex and ambiguous business requirements into technical solutions and deliver projects on schedule
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Position Description

De beste CRM-løsningene starter ikke med en funksjonsliste. De starter med å forstå hva som skal fungere bedre for kunden.

CGI søker flere kolleger til vårt Microsoft-miljø i Oslo. Vi ser etter deg som har praktisk erfaring med Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement og/eller Power Platform, og som liker å gjøre kundebehov om til løsninger som faktisk blir brukt.

Kanskje trives du best med kundedialog, workshops, prosesser og konfigurasjon. Kanskje foretrekker du Dataverse, integrasjoner, utvikling og teknisk løsningsdesign. Eller kanskje du er personen som får forretning og teknologi til å forstå hverandre.

Vi er ikke på jakt etter én person som kan alt. Vi skal ansette flere og ønsker kolleger med ulike og utfyllende styrker.

Dette kan du jobbe med:

Som konsulent hos CGI vil du jobbe tett med kunder og kolleger gjennom hele eller deler av leveransen – fra de første behovene til løsningen er tatt i bruk.

Avhengig av erfaring og interesse kan du blant annet:

Kartlegge behov og lede workshops med kunder og brukere
Rådgi kunder om CRM, kundeprosesser og bruk av Microsoft-plattformen
Konfigurere og videreutvikle Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service og andre relevante løsninger
Bygge apper, automatiseringer og brukerflater med Power Apps, Power Automate og Power Pages
Utforme datamodeller og løsninger i Dataverse
Arbeide med integrasjoner, API-er, Azure-tjenester og teknisk arkitektur
Bidra med testing, migrering, dokumentasjon, opplæring og innføring
Se forbedringsmuligheter og hjelpe kundene med å ta gode valg videre

Du vil samarbeide med funksjonelle konsulenter, utviklere, arkitekter og rådgivere. Hos oss skal du både kunne fordype deg i ditt eget fagområde og lære av kolleger med en annen bakgrunn enn deg selv.

Hvilken profil kjenner du deg mest igjen i?

Den funksjonelle konsulenten

Du liker å forstå hvordan kunden arbeider i dag, hva som bør bli bedre, og hvordan teknologien kan støtte dette. Du har gjerne erfaring med behovskartlegging, prosessarbeid, konfigurasjon, krav, workshops, opplæring eller innføring av nye løsninger.

Den tekniske konsulenten

Du liker å bygge, integrere og forbedre løsninger. Du kan ha erfaring med Dataverse, Power Platform, Azure, API-er, integrasjoner, løsningsarkitektur, ALM eller utvikling i C#, JavaScript eller TypeScript.

Brobyggeren

Du forstår både forretningsbehovene og de tekniske mulighetene. Du kan diskutere prosesser med kunden, samarbeide med utviklere og forklare tekniske valg på en forståelig måte.

Mange kombinerer elementer fra flere av disse profilene. Du trenger ikke å plassere deg i bare én kategori.

Dette mener vi bør være på plass

Vi ser først og fremst etter deg som:
Har praktisk erfaring med Dynamics 365 CE og/eller Power Platform
Har vært med på å levere eller videreutvikle løsninger i kundeprosjekter, produktteam eller interne digitaliseringsmiljøer
Forstår sammenhengen mellom prosesser, data, teknologi og brukerbehov
Liker kundedialog og kan stille gode spørsmål, gi råd og utfordre på en konstruktiv måte
Kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig
Tar ansvar for egne leveranser og deler kunnskap med andre

Det er positivt om du har erfaring med ett eller flere av disse områdene:

Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service eller Customer Insights
Power Apps, Power Automate eller Power Pages
Dataverse og datamodellering
Integrasjoner, Azure-tjenester og API-er
Migrering, testing, releaseprosesser eller kvalitetssikring
Microsoft-sertifiseringer

Dette er ikke en sjekkliste. Vi legger større vekt på hva du har jobbet med, hva du har lært, og hvilken retning du ønsker å utvikle deg i.

Derfor kan CGI være riktig sted for degHos CGI blir du en del av et internasjonalt teknologi- og rådgivningsselskap, samtidig som du jobber tett med kunder og kolleger i Norge.

En fleksibel arbeidshverdag, tilpasset oppdraget og samarbeidet med kunden

jobs.title: Software Engineer🚗
jobs.description:
Om oss 🚗

Siden starten i 2017 har Nettbil gjort bilsalg enklere og tryggere for privatpersoner ved å la flere bilforhandlere konkurrere om samme bil. Over 100 000 biler er solgt gjennom plattformen vår, til mer enn 2 000 forhandlere.

Vi er en del av Vend, den største markedsplass-operatøren i Norden. Med fokus på å utnytte teknologi og forbedre brukeropplevelsen, er Nettbil et av de mest spennende vekstselskapene i Norge. Hos oss er kultur nøkkelen: vi jobber sammen, vi er sultne på å lykkes, og vi jobber for å finne smarte løsninger.

Om rollen 🧑‍💻

Bak det som for kundene virker friksjonsfritt, ligger et kraftfullt maskineri. Vi gjør handelen enkel for begge parter: bileieren som skal selge, og forhandleren som skal kjøpe. Når en bil legges ut, byr forhandlerne på den i sanntid. Alt som skjer under budrunden må stemme.

Nettbil vokser, og teknologiorganisasjonen bygges ut i flere team med egne ansvarsområder. Vi er godt i gang med et moderniseringsløft der vi fornyer arkitekturen for enda mer vekst, og mange av valgene står fortsatt åpne. Du kommer inn mens det ennå er mye å ta stilling til.

Som Software Engineer vil du blant annet:

Videreutvikle auksjonsplattformen vår (hjertet av Nettbil!) som håndterer over 2 000 bilsalg hver måned
Bygge flatene bileiere og forhandlere møter oss gjennom, fra første prisestimat til gjennomført salg
Utforske hvordan AI og maskinlæring kan skape nye muligheter, fra automatiserte prosesser til systemer som oppdager avvik før de rekker å bli problemer
Gjøre modellene bak prisestimatene våre stadig mer treffsikre
Jobbe med integrasjoner mot eksterne aktører
Samarbeide tett med produktledere, designere, analytikere og andre utviklere
Løfte håndverket vårt, slik at teknologien aldri blir det som bremser oss

Ettersom vi er i sterk vekst ansetter vi flere, på ulike nivåer. Nøyaktig hva du jobber med, avhenger av hva du kan og hva du vil bli bedre på.

Hvem er du? 🌟

Du har stått i problemer uten opplagte svar, og vil vite hvorfor vi løser noe før du går i gang. Du bryr deg om koden din, også etter at PR-en er merget og i produksjon. Du utfordrer måten ting gjøres på, selv når den fungerer. Du ser noe nytt og lurer på hva vi kunne brukt det til. Du deler det du kan, og spør når du lurer.

Vi ser etter deg som:

Har jobbet som utvikler
Har relevant utdanning eller tilsvarende bakgrunn
Behersker norsk som arbeidsspråk
Kan møte opp på kontoret vårt på Økern

Teknologistacken vår 🚦

Det er ikke nødvendig å være ekspert på hele stacken vår; det viktigste er en solid forståelse av grunnleggende utviklingsprinsipper og gode tekniske ferdigheter. Dette er noe av det du kan forvente hos Nettbil:

Språk: TypeScript
Frontend: React Router, TanStack Query, Tailwind
Backend: Node.js
Databaser: PostgreSQL, MySQL
Infrastruktur: AWS, Kubernetes, OpenTofu
Køer: BullMQ
Testing: Cypress, Vitest

Vi har også teknologi utenfor listen over. Blant annet forvaltes innholdet vårt i Sanity (med Next.js), og til analyse og maskinlæring bruker vi Redshift og SageMaker, med innslag av språk som Python og Go. Datadog gir oss observerbarhet på tvers av tjenestene.

Hva vi kan tilby deg🌞

Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø preget av samarbeid, høy faglig kompetanse og felles ambisjoner.
Scale‑up med trygghet: del av Vend‑konsernet med støtte i ryggen og langsiktig satsing, kombinert med farten til en scale-up
Høy tillit, korte beslutningsveier og stor frihet i hvordan du løser oppgaver
Moderne kontorlokaler på Økern Portal med treningssenter, takterrasse og flere lunsjsteder.
Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling

Hos Nettbil blir du en del av et sammensveiset og engasjert miljø med rundt 100 kollegaer. Vi tror de beste løsningene skapes når mennesker med ulike erfaringer og perspektiver samarbeider, og legger derfor stor vekt på kunnskapsdeling, samarbeid og utvikling.

Vi holder til i toppetasjen på Økern Portal med utsikt over hele Oslo, takterasse, treningssenteret i bygget og flere gode lunsjsteder. Det er likevel menneskene som gjør arbeidsplassen vår spesiell. jobs.title: Data Architect
jobs.description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

Keyrus
is an international group of 2,800 consultants
and experts across 28 countries
, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.
For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills - you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, every deployment that compounds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates
.
Industrial discipline connects the two.

What You'll Architect

As a Data Architect, you will shape the data foundations that enable our clients to become truly intelligence-driven organizations. You will design scalable, future-proof data architectures, guide strategic technology decisions, and help clients transform complex business requirements into practical data solutions.

Define target-state data architectures across platform, integration, modelling, and consumption layers, and establish the roadmap to reach them.
Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models that support analytics, reporting, and operational use cases.
Architect modern cloud data platforms on Azure and/or AWS, including lakehouse, real-time integration, streaming, and hybrid architectures.
Evaluate and document key architectural decisions, balancing trade-offs such as build versus buy, batch versus streaming, and centralized versus federated approaches.
Act as a trusted advisor to business and IT stakeholders, translating strategic ambitions and operational constraints into realistic, scalable solutions.
Advise clients on data governance, master data management (MDM), metadata management, and data quality, considering both technology and organizational dimensions.
Contribute to solution design, client workshops, and RFP responses in collaboration with our sales and practice teams.
Guide delivery teams by establishing architectural standards, reviewing designs, and ensuring consistency, scalability, and maintainability across projects.
Mentor consultants and engineers, fostering architectural excellence within the Belgian practice.
Contribute to the continuous evolution of Keyrus reference architectures, methodologies, and accelerators.

Who You Are

You are a strategic thinker
with a strong technical foundation and a passion for designing data ecosystems that create business value. You enjoy combining technology, consulting, and stakeholder management
, and you are comfortable engaging with both executive decision-makers and technical teams.

You take ownership, communicate complex ideas clearly
, and can confidently challenge assumptions while building consensus across diverse stakeholder groups.

What You Bring

Qualifications / Experience

8+ years of experience in data and analytics, including at least 3 years in a Data Architect or Solution Architect role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data architectures, from strategy through implementation.
Strong expertise in data modelling, from conceptual and logical design to physical implementation.
Experience with ETL/ELT processes and modern data integration patterns, including real-time or event-driven architectures.
Solid understanding of data governance, MDM, metadata management, and data quality frameworks.
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both senior business stakeholders and technical teams.
Professional working proficiency in Dutch and English. French is a strong asset.
Eligibility to work in Belgium.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Technical Skills

You'll typically encounter technologies such as:

Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure (Fabric, Synapse, Data Factory, Purview) and/or AWS (Redshift, Glue, S3)
Data Platforms: Databricks, Snowflake, SAS Viya
Data Integration & Engineering: dbt, Kafka, Confluent, CDC tooling, ETL/ELT frameworks
Governance & Metadata: Collibra and related governance solutions
Analytics & Visualization: Power BI, Tableau
Programming & Querying: Python, SQL

We do not expect expertise in every technology listed above. We value deep expertise in a subset, combined with the architectural judgement to evaluate, integrate, and recommend the right technologies for each client context.

Nice-to-haves

Experience with AI and Generative AI architectures, including RAG patterns, agentic systems, vector databases, MLOps, and LLMOps.
Previous consulting or client-facing delivery experience.
Familiarity with architectural frameworks such as TOGAF and DAMA-DMBOK.
Experience with modern data architecture concepts such as Data Mesh, Data Products, Data Virtualization, and Logical Data Warehousing.
Exposure to multi-cloud environments, hybrid architectures, or large-scale transformation programs.

Rewards - What We Offer At Keyrus

Growth

At Keyrus we have created an environment where people are supported, challenged and connected to the people around them.

Working on impactful Data & Digital projects you will develop a broad and versatile skill set and stay ahead in a fast-evolving, AI-driven landscape.

Our digital learning platform, with over 30,000 courses including in-house trainings developed by our experts, is a perfect way to stay on top of your game

A generous training budget is available to help foster a culture where learning, feedback and continuous improvement is the norm

You will have a dedicated coach, benefit from regular check-ins, learn via different communities and have clear alignment with your team and company goals

We want you to grow with confidence. We therefore place a strong emphasis on ownership, open feedback and continuous development.

When people feel trusted, connected and inspired, they do their best work!

Rewards

Mobility budget? Car with fuel or charging car? We offer both so you can choose!

On top of that we also have daily and monthly net allowances, eco vouchers, hospitalisation (DKV) insurance and group insurance, as well as a generous bonus scheme that you can use on our flexible reward plan.

What We Stand For

Collective Intelligence
— Collaboration across expertise, functions, and geographies makes it possible to combine know-how and deliver more comprehensive responses to client challenges.

Reliability
— The ability to deliver complex projects with rigour is one of the pillars of our client relationship.

Pragmatism
— Prioritising concrete impact and measurable value over abstract technological discourse.

Entrepreneurial Spirit
— Curiosity, energy, and freedom are the foundations of our culture; they enable initiative and sustained innovation.

About Keyrus

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental AI to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. This is the discipline we call being an Architect of Intelligence
. Designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence
.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model™
(HOM), we architect reliable:

Intelligence Foundations,
Human in Command governance,
and Performance Steering,

To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time.

With 30+ years of expertise and 2,800 employees across 28 countries, we help organizations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organizations.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

For over 30 years, Keyrus have been Architects of intelligent systems. We have combined engineering, business consulting, data architecture, and AI in real operational environments. We have done this whilst never forgetting a more human enterprise of allowing humans to design, supervise, and shape what only they can create.. Find out more on our services on keyrus.com.

Do you enjoy working end-to-end on modern IT solutions and collaborating closely with customers? Then this role is for you!

We are looking for a (Senior) Fullstack Developer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting is the leading digital accelerator for innovation and sustainable value creation. We combine business design with software engineering to bring digital business to life.

With a team of around 280 highly qualified employees at our locations in Vienna, Graz, and Linz and a global team of 8,000 colleagues, we are constantly striving to develop and grow. Our customers trust in our solutions, which is why we are continuously looking for new talents.

As a (Senior) Fullstack Developer, you will take ownership of technical solutions from concept to production, actively contributing to architecture, technology choices, and implementation quality. You will work closely with customers and interdisciplinary teams, contribute to technical decision-making, and ensure high-quality delivery across both frontend and backend.

Design, develop, and implement high-quality fullstack solutions for customer projects
Work directly with customers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
Develop scalable backend services and modern frontend applications
Ensure high standards for code quality, security, performance, and maintainability
Participate in customer workshops, agile ceremonies, and solution discussions
Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends
Contribute to the design and implementation of cloud-native web solutions on hyperscaler platforms (e.g. Azure), including architecture decisions and best practices
Continuously evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and practices

4+ years of experience as Fullstack Developer
Strong proficiency both in frontend (React and/or Angular) and backend technologies (Java and/or C#)
Experience with RESTful APIs and microservices as well as with databases and cloud services
Experience in the use of AI-assisted development tools and methodologies (e.g., GitHub Copilot, coding agents / agentic coding) to enhance development productivity and code quality, as well as to support documentation, testing, and problem-solving activities
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployment workflows
Strong communication skills and a customer-oriented mindset
A curious mindset and willingness to learn and share knowledge
Very good German and English skills

As a person, we believe you are a team player who takes action and demonstrates responsibility to organize your work and solve your tasks. With our agile end-to-end development process, you will continue to both learn from, and coach your colleagues, so communication is important for us. Technology is developing fast, so learning new innovative technologies is something you strive to do.

We offer

We offer you professional growth, meaningful projects, open culture, and an outstanding work-life balance!
We offer you an opportunity to create the future of a growing, fast-developing, and important sector.
We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful.
We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.
Additionally, we offer benefits like laptop and smartphone also for private use, health programs, team events, excellent public transport connection, food vouchers, contribution to the costs of the Austrian “Klimaticket”, fresh fruits, the perfect environment to prosper professionally, and a lot more.
Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle where you need to unlearn and relearn every day as new possibilities emerge.

The annual gross salary for this position will start from € 55.000,00 on a full-time basis, depending on your qualifications and experience. Our aim is to provide you with a salary package that is both competitive and reflective of your relevant experience, while also aligning with current market standards.

Did we get you inspired? 

We look forward to your online application!

Please attach your CV or LinkedIn-profile and we will reach out to you. Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact us: careers.austria@tieto.com

Hope to hear from you soon!

Location: Vienna, Linz, Graz, Berlin, Regensburg

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Windows (VPN)
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right
. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar, tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives.

We are profitable and independent with no VC control. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

The role:

As an engineer on our small Windows VPN team, you will be responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and evolving Proton’s applications on Windows. You will be involved in the entire application lifecycle, from feature design and implementation to CI/CD configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operational incident response. You will collaborate closely with product managers and engineers across the company to deliver privacy‑preserving products used by millions of people worldwide.

Our codebase is primarily written in .NET and WinUI (C#/XAML), and we are building and integrating cross‑platform logical core libraries written in Rust.

Software quality is central to this role. You will help define, maintain, and improve our testing stack, which includes unit tests, integration tests, and automated GUI tests (using FlaUI).

What we are looking for:

Strong experience in C# and .NET development.
Strong experience building and maintaining Windows desktop applications using frameworks such as WinUI, WPF, or similar.
Solid understanding of MVVM architecture, dependency injection, asynchronous programming (async/await), and event‑based messaging patterns.
Proven ability to write maintainable, well‑tested, and scalable codebases.
Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
A strong understanding of software architecture and engineering best practices.
An appreciation for user experience and design quality.
Rust experience is not required but is a significant plus.
Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing concepts) and an interest in VPN technologies and protocols.
Experience with code debugging, profiling, and performance optimization on Windows.
Familiarity with Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) and modern collaborative development practices.
Experience with gradual rollout, and observability tooling (telemetry, metrics, monitoring and alerting).

Even if you don’t meet every requirement listed above, if you’re passionate about privacy and believe you could be a great fit, we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

Work that Matters: millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable. (read more about our impact here)
A great Team: Our team is diverse, collaborative, and tight-knit with people coming from all walks of life, including many of the world’s top academic institutions and organizations, such as MIT, Harvard, Stanford, Caltech, Cambridge, and ETH.
Technology: you'll get the right hardware and the right software you need to do your best work.
Learning & Development: we invest in your growth because sharp people make us better. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career because you'll be thrown into real challenges, with real ownership, from day one.
Employee Benefits: your wellbeing isn't an afterthought. We offer strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support so you can bring your best self to work every day
Stock Options: at Proton, we all have the opportunity to be owners of the company. From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
In-Person Collaboration: Amazing things happen when passionate, smart, and purposeful people get together in the same room. With offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London and more, you'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face with people who genuinely care about what they're building
Food: Lunch and snacks are on us every day in our offices so you can focus on the work and not on what's for lunch.
Transport: getting to the office shouldn't cost you. We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking, whichever works for you.
Flexible Working: you own your schedule. Set hours that work for you and your team — because outcomes matter more than when the clock says you started.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Proton, we believe diversity drives innovation and strengthens our mission to provide privacy as a default for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical ability, or socio-economic background, feel valued and empowered. We strive to create equal opportunities, promote open dialogue, and support continuous learning to ensure every voice is heard and respected.

If you need any extra support or reasonable adjustments during the hiring process, please let your talent partner know.

Candidate Privacy Notice

When you apply for a position, refer a candidate, or are considered for a role at Proton Technologies AG (Proton, we, us, or our), your information is stored in Greenhouse, in accordance with their Service Privacy Policy. This information is used to evaluate your suitability for the posted position. We also retain this information for consideration for future roles that you may apply for or that we believe may align with your background and skills.

If we no longer have a legitimate business need to process your information, we will either delete or anonymize it. Should you have any inquiries about how we use or manage your information, or if you wish to access, correct, or delete your data, please contact our privacy team at careers@proton.ch.

Proton does not accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from candidates. We will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from an unsolicited offer, even if the candidate is subsequently hired by Proton.

To learn more about our privacy policy, please vis it our privacy policy page .

Vilnius: 33,800 - 64,000 EUR gross annually*
